Read CITATION.cff and the source-provider credits. Review evidence: h0/results/H0_CHECKS.json and h0/INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md. Measurements establish source counts and numerical consistency only, not physical validation, a complete application, superiority or an official final submission. Energy efficiency, speed, lower CO2/water use, reuse/recycling and renewable energy are design aims; no benefit in these quantities has been measured here.
